results.content: Also on Friday's docket is the University of Michigan's preliminary August consumer sentiment index. The consensus forecast calls for a reading of 54.9, down from the final July print of 55.2. A weaker-than-expected reading could signal that households are growing more cautious, while a stronger number might suggest resilience despite elevated borrowing costs.
